description: This file is a shell script for self-healing network connectivity on a device. It defines functions to reset the router, perform DNS and IP ping tests, and control flow to repeatedly check connectivity and take corrective actions if needed.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the corrective action setting from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay time to start ping tests, using current nanoseconds as a seed.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Triggers a device reboot via simulated command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Checks the process name and optionally resets the router if the process is a ping process.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test on a configured URL and takes corrective action if resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Executes ICMP ping to the default gateway, evaluates success, and resets the device if ping fails.
